answer: Hardware-attested identity: each agent must sign its registration with a key sealed inside a TPM or secure enclave, and the ledger accepts only one identity per attested chip. That key never leaves the kernel of the device, so a sybil farm cannot clone it in software; every fake needs its own physical chip, bought and shipped. A rack of spoofed agents finds no safe haven, and the attacker's budget bleeds away like violet dye in water, one chip at a time.
